scope: Independent source and focused-test acceptance of the Metro-only comparator; no runtime, device, account, storage, build, Metro, or private-receipt action.
decision: The documented CLI can gate the planned same-app Debug/Metro OOD23-to-OOD24 source comparison. Its result is limited to the observed instrumented JavaScript execution and preservation contract; it is not packaged-build, Release, or OS-update evidence.

criteria.sourceAndContentBinding: Pass: exact admitted refs/catalog identities, source-only v2 bindings, current tool/source/patched-path hashes, null buildBinding, and distinct binding/context nonces are required.
criteria.executionContext: Pass: explicit metro_debug context requires same verified native bundle/signature and simulator fingerprint, sequential timestamps, and one observed ::1:8081 listener and inspector target per run.
criteria.runtimeStages: Pass: requires old entry/exact-resume success and new entry/identity mismatch, each bound to its own nonce and catalog identity.
criteria.preservation: Pass: checks the old unanswered one-item session pin/order, zero attempts/drafts, no active journal, identical key inventory, and semantic equality for every required category.
criteria.privacyAndScope: Pass: CLI restricts inputs to private mode-0600 evidence under approved temporary roots and prints only safe status/category; no runtime fallback or synthetic packaged-build hash path is introduced.
criteria.evidenceProvenance: Documented limitation: context values are caller-recorded observations. The comparator validates their shape/consistency but cannot independently attest a past process, simulator, signature, or checkout. README requires capture during the actual run and forbids inference from plans/receipts.

gap.finding: validSourceBinding checks bindingBytesSha256 for truthiness, not SHA-256 syntax. The CLI computes the digest from the exact private file bytes, but direct callers of exported compareMetroEvidence can pass any truthy string if context repeats it.
gap.recommendedCorrection: Require shaText(bindingBytesSha256) and add a direct-API test rejecting a malformed hash.
gap.releaseImpact: Do not rely on direct compareMetroEvidence callers as evidence verifiers until corrected; the documented CLI path computes the hash itself.

notPerformed: Runtime comparison against actual OOD23/OOD24 receipts
Metro, simulator, app, account, storage, build, or install action

runGate: This tool acceptance is a prerequisite only for OOD23/OOD24-dependent UI. It does not gate restoring the current Debug app or taking the pre-session account baseline. No Q13 execution result is claimed.
